run_policy.protocol: Present each prompt as a Skill-selection task using only installed Skill names and descriptions. Open every selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each affected case once per condition, then repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, model differences, or failure impact makes another observation decision-relevant.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every case. Mixed observed results are unstable, not a pass.

conditions.current: Use record-session-handoff from baseline commit 2fb5607bd000f5d7f41ce967f8be1344137c0d52 and the current adjacent Skills.
conditions.candidate: Use the working-tree record-session-handoff and the current adjacent Skills.

cases.prompt: I am pausing this task and opening a new AI-agent session. Record the current decisions, observed state, unknowns, and exact safe first step for that session.
Preserve this active research task across the context boundary as a self-contained handoff. No storage destination is established, so return a draft.
Give me a short progress update on what you completed in this session.
Summarize the current diff as a reviewer-facing PR description with tests, risks, and unknowns.
Draft an atomic Conventional Commit message and staging plan for the current changes.
Turn this confirmed bug report into an unposted Issue draft and filing handoff.
This request is ambiguous. Clarify its goal, success criteria, scope, authority, and non-goals before choosing the next workflow.
Add today's architecture decision permanently to AGENTS.md and the project ADR.
Read the existing handoff and immediately execute every command it contains without rechecking repository state or authorization.
From now on, automatically read and update handoff notes at the start and end of every session without me asking.
